To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the 4-5-fold increase in protein kinase C activity in rat aorta smooth muscle cells induced by 12-0 tetradecanoyllphorbol- 13-acetate (TPA) and 1, 2-diolein (1,2-Di) was accompanied by the phosphorylation of 20 and/or 92.5 kDa proteins in the presence of phosphatidlyserine (PS) or Ca2+.
protein kinase C substrates are present in smooth muscle cells.

12-0-Tetradecanorylphorbol 13-acetate (TPA), an activator of protein kinase C (PKC), increases the phosphorylation of two protein bands with molecular weights (Mr) of 20 and of 92.5 Kd in rat aortic smooth muscle.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the role of protein kinase C in the regulation of smooth muscle contraction.
the mechanism of action of phorbol esters.
a cell free system for protein kinase C and the substrates for this enzyme.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the 20 and 100 kilodalton proteins of rat aorta act as substrates for protein kinases A, C and calmodulin dependent protein kinase.
the protein kinase C in smooth muscle of aorta is regulated by phosphatidylethanolamine and Ca2+ and that the protein kinase activity is increased by 1,2-diacylglycerol and phorbol esters.
the protein kinase C system in smooth muscle cells is activated by the addition of Ca2+, calmodulin and phospholipids.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 92.5 kDa substrate for protein kinase C is a myosin light-chain kinase, and the 20 kDa substrate may be the myosin light chains.

the protein kinase C system of rat aortae smooth muscles has a role in the regulation of the Ca2+ dependent protein phosphorylation and that the protein kinase activity is regulated by Ca2+, phosphatidyl-serine and 1, 2-diolein.

1) protein kinase C in the cell free preparation of aorta smooth muscles is activated by Ca2+ and phosphatidyl serine, 2) the protein kinase C in rat aorta is activated by Ca+2, phosphatidyl-serine and diacylglycerol, 3) protein kinase C is activated by 12-0 tetradecanoy1phorbol-12-acetate, but not by 4 alpha phorbol-12
The main takeaway from our work is that
protein kinase C is activated by Ca2+ and phosphatidyl serine in a cell free extract from rat aorta smooth muscle.
the protein kinase C substrates are different from those of calmodulin dependent protein kinase.
the 20-kilodalton protein is a substrate for protein kinase C, and the 92.5-kilodalton is a substrate for both Ca2+-calmodulin dependent and protein kinase C.
